newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products flat to weaker, except gas oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products flat to weaker, except gas oil.

text.p: NWE oil products were weaker except for stronger gas oil.
Fuel oil trade was quiet. Barges recovered from Wednesday's lows to trade at $82 and $82.50 fob ARA. High sulphur cargoes were bid at $77, with low sulphur quiet.
Gasoline was flat to weaker in a dull market, with Eurograde barges trading at $194.50 fob ARA in late trade.

Naphtha was slightly weaker on negative sentiment related to Sonatrach's decision to suspend the loading of large May naphtha cargoes out of Skikda. Gas oil was pulled nearly $2 higher by futures. Diesel premiums rose about $1-2 on tight supply.
